sources.label: 🧩 Android patches for Morphe: AMOLED themes, ad removal and premium unlocks. Pro
sources.author: hxreborn
patch_list: Enables guest sign-in without a Google account.
Signs in through GmsCore instead of Google Play Services. Requires GmsCore to be installed.
Removes the credit limit on bulk imports. Doesn't affect the weekly limit on single imports.
Unlocks Pro and Max features. Import limits are not included.
